Class CborMessageHandler<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.serde.cbor.body.CborMessageHandler<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type to read/write
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.http.body.MessageBodyHandler<T>, io.micronaut.http.body.MessageBodyReader<T>, io.micronaut.http.body.MessageBodyWriter<T>, io.micronaut.http.body.ResponseBodyWriter<T>
@Order(10) @Singleton @ProducesCbor @ConsumesCbor public final class CborMessageHandler<T> extends Object implements io.micronaut.http.body.MessageBodyHandler<T>, io.micronaut.http.body.ResponseBodyWriter<T>
HTTP message body handler for CBOR using Micronaut Serialization.

Object mapping is performed by CborObjectMapper (build-time serdes + streaming CBOR tokens). Jackson Databind is not used.

Since:
3.1.0
